title: Sebastian and the Inheritance
author: Edmund Joubert
blurb: Ulyana Underhill, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
